_doc: F-16 air-to-air stations (flight/weapons/stations.js). Station positions: aircraft/f16.json stores.stations (BMS model 1052 slots). Body frame of core: x right, y up, z aft, metres. Types: lb (mass), drag (BMS drag units, same scale as f16.json stores: dCD = units x dragPerUnit(Mach)), model (models/f16-stores/<model>.glb, origin = attachment point), cm (mass point and launch point from the attachment point). Racks: slot = where the missile's attachment point sits on the rack. Sources: docs/flight-notes/f16-stations.md.

AIM-9M._src: BMS 4.38 Falcon4_WCD.xml WCD 174 'AIM-9M Sidewinder' Weight 189, Drag 4, CtIdx 225 -> model 1691; cm = centre of the model's bounding box (ESTIMATE)

AIM-120C._src: BMS 4.38 Falcon4_WCD.xml WCD 159 'AIM-120C AMRAAM' Weight 338, Drag 4, CtIdx 1699 -> model 2016; cm = centre of the model's bounding box (ESTIMATE)

LAU-129P._src: BMS 4.38 Falcon4_WCD.xml WCD 661 'R LAU-129+16S300' Weight 95, Drag 2, CtIdx 1858 -> model 1663 (BmsRack.dat f16-2/8, f16-3/4, f16-6/7: pylon MRL, pylonct 1858); slot = the model's store slot; cm = bounding-box centre (ESTIMATE)

racks._src: BmsRack.dat definegroup f16-wingtip: pylonct 0, rack aim-no-rail (rackct 0) -> the missile hangs on the station slot itself (rail part of the airframe model 1052); f16-2/8 and f16-3/4 / f16-6/7: pylon MRL pylonct 1858

fireOrder._src: ESTIMATE: outboard missiles first for AIM-9 (wingtips), inboard first for AIM-120, alternating left / right
